title: Rain Ripples
subtitle: Angled view of colorful raindrops on water
description: Raindrops strike an angled water surface and burst into expanding rainbow ripples. A lattice of dots recedes toward the horizon, lighting up in shifting hues as each elliptical wavefront sweeps through it, with additive glow rings tracing the surface. Inspired by Okazz's #p5js raindrop study.

parameters.label: View Angle
parameters.description: Tilt of the camera above the water surface (lower = more oblique)

parameters.label: Rainfall
parameters.description: Number of raindrops striking the surface per second

parameters.label: Ripple Speed
parameters.description: How fast each ripple ring expands outward

parameters.label: Ripple Reach
parameters.description: Maximum radius a ripple travels before fading out

parameters.label: Dot Spacing
parameters.description: Screen spacing of the water dot lattice

parameters.label: Hue Shift
parameters.description: Rotates the rainbow palette around the color wheel
